model.title: National Park System Long-Term Lease Investment Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Thomas Tillis (R-NC)

summary.text: The bill would allow the Interior Secretary to renew certain leases at national parks and related sites without requiring competitive bidding, streamlining the process for extending existing agreements.
